{{Quote|After we'd wiped out the leaders, and a few villages, the survivors took arms against us, can you imagine?|Imperial Officer|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 80">[[Star Wars (1977) 80|''Star Wars'' (1977) 80]]</ref>}}
This '''Imperial Officer''' was in charge of [[Dead Castle]] on [[Dennaskar]] around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Biography==
This [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was present for the attack on this [[Planet/Legends|planet]], where he helped the Imperials [[Death/Legends|wipe out]] the populace. After the planet's people had been wiped out, the officer was stationed in the planet's former seat of government. At some point, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] visited the planet to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] [[Tay Vanis]]. Vanis' mind was eventually destroyed, and he was forced into a [[persistent vegetative state]]. Vader kept the destroyed man in a small locked room within the castle, and the officer was one of the only men to know Vanis' location.

Around 3 ABY, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] came to the planet searching for Tay Vanis. They were eventually able to meet up with [[LE-914]], Vanis' droid, who led them to the castle. Skywalker was able to take the officer captive, and he led them to the small locked room. Upon unlocking the room, a pre-recorded [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Vader appeared to speak to the Rebels, to taunt them for having only found Vanis after he had already been tortured into a coma. As the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] listened to the message, the officer stole Organa's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and turned it against her. However, Organa quickly grabbed Skywalker's weapon and shot the man through the forehead, killing him.
